items.summary: gate03.com is live in the registry and queue-ready, but analytics is not configured and the snapshot contains no site-specific page, SEO, health, monetization, or active-work evidence. Record exact candidate files, current behavior, evidence gaps, and one reversible implementation that can be admitted next.
